actual_scope: Construct rational special-orthogonal witnesses, arbitrarily close to identity, for false complete dirty inverse-circuit identities.
scope_change_reason: The completed inverse frontend and SPD realization leave extra operator relations open. This theorem preserves inverse equals transpose. Nonlinear Cayley substitution needs a shortest nonzero coefficient; a longer nonzero coefficient can fail.
bottleneck_link: Removes the inverse-versus-transpose gap for the generic rational grammar. Finite native alphabets and their other relations still require a separate binding.
stop_rule: Stop at the orthogonal witness theorem, finite rational grid and full literal replay. Do not claim a native Clifford witness, numerical separation or a kappa improvement.
